**The build passes now.** One real error, hidden in all that noise:

`src/core/settings.js` set `maxRetries: retries`, but `retries` was never defined. That threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined` and killed the link stage.

It now reads `env.retries` and falls back to a new `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` of 3, which is what the comment there always promised.

Build exits 0. The 3 warnings are still there, all cosmetic:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| W1042 deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| W2213 unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| W3307 circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Those files don't exist on disk, so the warnings are baked into `build.js` itself.
